spec.title: Input equations that read a primitive parameter (H5's rest): the same verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
spec.description: A regression check's correspondence (step H5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md) may now give an input equation whose expression reads the new version's primitive parameters as well as the object's fields: over the line kernel in lib/tests/heap.rs (Line(long total) before, Line(long price) now, a count n taken by both versions), old.l.total == new.l.price * new.n. The harness makes the previous object from the new leaves and the parameter before the calls, and compares the expression over the new object's paths and n with the previous field after them. Inline on the own checker: discounted and reprice verified; a discount from the eleventh item refuted in the result and a unit price set to the line's amount refuted in field:l.total, both witnesses run on a JVM. This job runs the ignored test that repeats the four under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm, where JBMC checks the same harness (the previous leaf computed from the parameter in its bytecode).
spec.expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both engines: after discounted and after reprice Verified, defect discounted and defect reprice Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM (counterexample.jvm set).
